text:
maya: Quick sync — working draft playbook for marketplace security artifact ingest. We need a simple, repeatable flow for SOC/pen/questionnaire artifacts from partners (cloud + HW + SI). Can we align owners and TTLs before Q3 listing drives?

sam: Love it. Can you drop the proposed steps?

maya: Sure. TL;DR: 1) Partner uploads artifacts to presigned S3 (or GCP equivalent) 2) Verify ownership + redact PII 3) Attach attestations + mapping file 4) Ingest to secure bucket with ACLs + immutable audit log 5) TTL & periodic re-request (12 months standard; 6 months for high-risk) 6) Notify marketplace review queue.

nate: +1. A few security notes: presigned links must expire short (24h), uploads scanned by virus-scan lambda, and we need an HSM-signed manifest for any SOC/pen that contains signatures.

oliver: From infra: we can auto-issue presigned URL via a service account. Proposed command example for partners (put in docs):

```
POST https://upload.redwood.example/partner-artifacts
Body: {"partner_id": "acme", "file_type": "soc2", "return_url": "https://drive"}
Response: {"upload_url": "https://s3.amazonaws.com/...", "expires_in": 1440}
```

oliver: We'll create an ingestion lambda that tags objects with partner_id + hash and moves to secure-archive bucket.

emma: Ops/process note: we need a redaction checklist (PII, credentials, internal IPs). Can we require a one-line attestation from partner: `We have redacted PII per marketplace policy v1.2` and a contact email?

maya: Yes. Attestation template will be part of the upload form. Also propose a minimal metadata schema: `partner_id`, `artifact_type`, `artifact_date`, `contact_email`, `redaction_attestation`, `risk_tier` (low|medium|high).

nate: For pen-tests we need a high-risk flow: 1) redacted summary allowed for listing 2) full report only shared with SOC reviewers via ephemeral access + NDA 3) store full report encrypted with customer-managed key (if partner requests)

sam: Who owns re-request cadence and TTL enforcement? I can take ownership for initial wave of marketplace partners. Would like a way to bulk re-request artifacts for older listings.

maya: Sam owning cadence sounds good. Sam — can you draft the initial communication template for the re-request (aim for 30-day window + automated reminders at 7/3/1 days)?

sam: Yep. I'll put in the draft and tag legal for wording.

marketplace-bot: new checklist created: "artifact-ingest-playbook-v0.1" assigned to @sam, review due in 7 days. :robot_face:

oliver: Question — retention TTL: default 365 days for all artifacts, but for hardware vendor evidence that includes firmware blobs we probably want longer (730 days). Thoughts?

nate: Agree on 365 default, 730 for HW. Also add a field `retention_justification` when setting >365. That helps audits.

emma: Ops will need a restore/playback runbook for audits. I'll draft the S3 lifecycle + restore permissions doc.

maya: Great. Action items: Sam = communication template + owner of cadence; Emma = restore/runbook + redaction checklist; Oliver = presign API + ingestion lambda; Nate = pen-test/HSM signature guidance + NDA access flow. I'll consolidate into the playbook doc and circulate.

sam: Quick Q — do we want automated redaction checks (regex) before ingest or leave manual?

nate: Start manual for now, but log flagged patterns and create a follow-up ticket to add automated regex/ML redaction (phase 2).

maya: Proposed timeline: draft playbook this week, internal review next week, pilot ingest with two HW partners and one cloud marketplace partner in 3 weeks.

sam: Sounds good. I'll drop a calendar invite for a 30-min pilot coordination.

oliver: Will add a basic dashboard metric: ingest success rate, average upload time, number of flagged redactions.

marketplace-bot: reminder set for pilot kickoff in 21 days.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the consolidated playbook link once I add the templates. :thumbsup:

sam: :raised_hands:

nate: :eyes:

emma: 👍
